Report.methodNote: Method: statements were voted agree/disagree/pass; camps are opinion clusters (PCA + k-means, k chosen by silhouette); bridges and conflict lines follow Polis-style significance tests; the diagnosis is computed deterministically from configured thresholds. Points were extracted from submissions by a language model and released editorially; every step is audit-logged.
